author: bardic-inspiration
name: Stormlit Shortbow
summary: A shortbow that crackles faintly and adds a spark of lightning to its arrows.
description: The limbs are bound with copper wire. Archers who carry it report that their hair stands on end before rain.

stats.effect: You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When you hit a target with an arrow fired from it, the target takes an extra 1d4 Lightning damage.
